name: The High Chieftain
summary: A tauren elder sends you to Thunder Bluff to ask Cairne Bloodhoof for an audience. Your defense of your people has earned recognition.

sections.title: A Chieftain’s Deed
sections.body: Cairne Bloodhoof led the effort to reclaim these plains from the centaurs alongside the young Warchief Thrall. As High Chieftain, he can recognize your part in defending your people.

faq.q: Who am I being sent to see?
faq.answer: You are asked to seek an audience with Cairne Bloodhoof, the High Chieftain of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why am I going to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Your courage in defending your people has earned recognition, and you are asked to seek an audience with Cairne Bloodhoof.
Cairne Bloodhoof and the young Warchief Thrall led the effort to reclaim the plains from the centaurs.
Cairne Bloodhoof is in Thunder Bluff, on the central rise.

angles.text: As a tauren, you are sent to Cairne Bloodhoof after defending your people. He led the effort to reclaim the plains alongside Thrall.

attribution: In-game quest text: The High Chieftain
